[/b][size=6][b]PLEASE READ THE STICKY'D COMMENT FOR A HUGE UPDATE.[/b][/size]


Hi there! Thanks for downloading my mod!
Please note that this is my first time attempting to do anything coding related, so if there are hiccups, please let me know!
Please consult this here and the included readme for a spoiler free guide as to what is going on with this mod and my suggestions!


----------------------------------------------------
[b][u][size=4]THINGS TO NOTE[/size][/u]
[/b]
[b][i][u][size=3]Trigger Warnings[/size][/u][/i][/b]: There is talk of body mutilation, cutting, stalking, possessive/obsessive behavior, attempted murder, child abuse, dark/rough sexual talk, and a physical fight between a male and female character. (While the fight is one simple punch by the male, I wanted to include this as a warning for those who are not comfortable with this. It's for storytelling, nothing more.)
While almost none of this is discussed in graphic detail, I want to be forthright with what is in this mod for those who are NOT comfortable with the above. The most intense is the sexual talk.
***********
There is A LOT of cursing. There is A LOT of sexual innuendos and, later on, actual sexual talk. I tried to not go into a lot of graphic detail however. This is not suggested as a mod for streaming due to the 18+ dialogue. (However, I guess if you can put videos of a game like House Party on YouTube, you could probably get away with this mod...? I don't know. Please be smart and use your own discretion for streaming/video purposes. You do have my full permission to showcase this mod at any time.)
************
This mod assumes that you will pursue Sebastian or Abigail as your partner. Please choose the path that is right for you. Both are unique and have their own intrigue, although, the Abigail mod was made much later than the Sebastian mod. It is not as packed with features due to me not being sure where to go with it.
************
Please talk to the following characters daily (or frequently) in order to not miss their dialogue!
Sebastian
Abigail
Sam
Haley
Alex
Robin has two spots of dialogue: the day after the Flower Dance and the day after the Luau. Will expand her in the future.
************
This mod has LGBT+ themes in it as well, as two characters (Sebastian and Abigail) are pursuing your hand in love. There are also two other LGBT+ couples later in the story.
************
[i][b]ALL CHARACTERS INVOLVED ARE 18+ IN MY EYES FOR THE MOD.[/b][/i] Here are the ages mentioned, or I have decided on, for this mod:
Abigail: 23
Sam: 25
Sebastian: 25
Haley: 24
Alex: 23
Maru: 18 (she is not involved in any part in this mod, but her age is sort of relevant for one part of Sebastian's story)
**************
At this time, I have not edited the event for the Flower Dance, so I suggest that you use your imagination for how it goes. (I haven't had the opportunity to really play with that yet.)
Do be sure to at least grab your favorite romantic song and play it during the dance to get the best effect. ;)
...Or find a great meme song to really fuck up the narrative. Because I'm always here for a good meme joke.

[b][size=4]Big shoutout to Isa and their Yandere Sebastian mod for getting me interested in working on my own mod! PLEASE GO CHECK OUT AND DOWNLOAD THEIR MOD!! https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5064[/size][/b]

[size=4][b][u]NOTE FOR TRANSLATORS:[/u][/b] [/size][size=3][b]Please keep this as accurate to the original as possible. [/b][i]DO NOT ALTER SUBJECT MATTER OF ANY KIND IN TRANSLATIONS UNLESS IT IS REQUIRED FOR EASE OF UNDERSTANDING[/i][/size][b][size=3]. Please and thank you.
Otherwise, feel free to translate at your heart's content.[/size]

[u][size=4]NOTE FOR MODDERS: [/size][/u][size=3]If you would like to use my mod as an example to learn how to code events and dialogue mods, feel free to do so. Please do not however repeat exact phrasing of anything I have written into your own mod if you are going to upload it for public use.[/size][/b]

----------------------------------------------------
[b][u][size=4]Overview[/size]
[/u][/b]
This mod provides a story to spice up year one in Pelican Town. This mod DOES NOT schedule changes at this time. It is largely focused on being a dialogue & event mod. Sebastian has dialogue for every day at every 2 heart levels per season. There is also set dialogue for him, Sam, Abigail, Haley, Alex, and Robin on certain days of the year. These are typically LONGER than a usual conversation in SDV, so please keep that in mind! Sebastian also has new dialogue for before each festival, during each festival, and after each festival. Most other characters also have post-day festival dialogue as well! 
Please see the below section for a guide as to which set days have dialogues and events!

Did some light math on the approximate lines of dialogue for this mod and it's probably 3000 or more? There are 650 entries total, but most entries have 3-10 'boxes' (times a box pops up/has you continue) of dialogue a piece. So it's hefty.

[size=4][b][i][u]PLEASE NOTE:[/u][/i][/b][/size][size=2]  [/size][size=3]This mod is a dialogue mod, therefore, it WILL conflict with other mods that also edit Abigail or Sebastian's dialogue. The mod that is alphabetically at the bottom will overwrite any mod that is alphabetically before it. Therefore, this mod would overwrite Doki Doki Sebastian for example, but my mod would be overwritten by Isa's Yandere Sebastian mod. I personally suggest either setting up different profiles in Vortex for certain mods, or having different save files for your dialogue mods. (And of course keeping track of which ones use what mods.) Each of our mods take up the same dialogue slots in the game, therefore, they will conflict with one another.

As for other characters, there are a lot less conflicts, therefore, you can have dialogue mods for Sam, Alex, and/or Haley and they will likely not conflict but once in a blue moon. If I add more dialogue later that add to their typical dialogue pools, then this would change to be similar to Abigail and Sebastian.[/size]

-------------------------------------------------------
[b][u][size=3]Sebastian Overhauls
[/size][/u][/b]
Sebastian goes from incredibly shy and nervous to a downright horny bastard. Really honed in on the nerdy and socially inept/awkward parts of Sebastian's character. Basically basement dwelling virgin Sebastian. You're welcome?

Here are the list of events:
[b]New! 3+ heart event - 40% chance to happen on a Friday night, 8pm - 12pm[/b]
4 heart event - Impossible to miss
Spring 20 - 7pm - 11pm at the Mountain
Summer 24 - 12pm - 5pm at the Beach
6 hearts and also 6 hearts with Abigail - Also impossible to miss; [b][u]BE SURE TO HAVE THE FIRST HOUSE UPGRADE BY THIS POINT![/u][/b]
Summer 26 - 8pm - 11pm at the Town
Secret 10 Heart event - Go to the most unlikely places for Seb to be
[size=1][s](Psst, it's the pool of the bath-house from 5-11pm.)[/s][/size]

List of specific day dialogue:
Spring: 12, 14, 23, 25
Summer: 4, 10, 12, 17, 20, 27
Fall: 8, 13, 15, 21, 26
Winter: 7, 9, 15, 19, 24, 28
Each season has it's own 2, 4, 6, 8, and 10 heart daily dialogues. (Which are recycled weekly, just kinda how SDV dialogue works.)

[b]New! Edited Vanilla event dialogue! The only ones left in tact from the original are the 6 heart and 14 heart events. I like them as they are.
New! Bouquet, Engagement, and Marriage dialogue! - All of these lines are unique to this mod! (There's, like, one marriage line I kept from vanilla because it's cute af)
New! Assorted dialogue edits! - Items in Seb's room are described differently, playing pool with Sam has different dialogue for Seb, doctor's visit dialogue changed, and more!
[/b]
----------------------------------------------------------
[b][u][size=3]Sam Overhauls
[/size][/u][/b]
Sam is basically the farmer's best friend in this case. Enthusiastic music dork. I wanted to flesh him out a bit and give him more of a really chipper best friend vibe. A bit of a shit-head though, can't take that away from him.

He has one solo event with the farmer:
Spring 18: 10am to 7pm at Sam's House
[b]New! Event at the pier - Have to see Abigail's new event first, but it happens between 10am - 6pm.[/b]

List of specific day dialogue:
Spring: 10, 25
Summer: 1, 8, 12, 15, 22, 26
Fall: 6, 14, 17, 28
Winter: 24

He does not have any changes to his regular dialogue pool.

-------------------------------------------------------------
[b][u][size=3]Abigail Overhauls in Sebastian's Playthrough
[/size][/u][/b]
Abigail is the uninhibited, spunky girl best friend. Who also has a huge crush on you. Made her a bit of a sarcastic spit-fire with a heart of gold, just a more emphasized version of her original self. [b]Abigail has been slightly tweaked to be more aggressive towards Sebastian.[/b]

Shared event with Sebastian: 6 hearts for both characters (impossible to miss) - [b][u]HAVE FIRST HOUSE UPGRADE BY THIS POINT![/u][/b]
[b]New! Solo Abby event at the farmhouse: 8am - 12pm[/b]

List of specific day dialogue:
Spring: 8, 14, 25, 28
Summer: 6, 12, 14, 27
Fall: 5, 15, 17, 28
Winter: 24

She does not have any changes to her regular dialogue pool.

-------------------------------------------------------------
[b][u][size=3]Haley Overhauls[/size][/u][/b]
Her dialogue is super light and there isn't much, but she is involved in the story. I might come back to her later and add more dialogue in the future. Her personality is super flirty, but she's a lot less snarky and mean. She's rather level-headed, but likes to tease.
There is one other important element, but I'll let the story tell that one. It's put out there pretty quickly.

List of specific day dialogue:
Spring: 25
Summer: 3, 12, 27
Fall: 5
Winter: None

She does not have any changes to her regular dialogue pool.

--------------------------------------------------------------
[b][u]Alex Overhauls[/u][/b]
His is also super light. He is however involved in the story. He's headstrong and flirtatious, but more on the joking side. Definitely a macho dude though. There is another important element to him, but I'll let the story tell that one. His is later in the story, but definitely be sure to keep an eye on his set dialogue later.

List of specific day dialogue:
Spring: 15, 25
Summer: 9, 12, 16
Fall 10, 17

He does not have any changes to his regular dialogue pool.

---------------------------------------------------------------
[b][u][size=3]New! Event with Robin! - 6 hearts with Sebastian is required. No specific time, Robin just has to be at her house.[/size][/u][/b]

---------------------------------------------------------------

I think that's it! I really, really hope people like this mod as I've worked on this for about a month testing, re-testing, overhauling dialogue multiple times, and I put a lot of love into making it entertaining. It won't be for every SDV player, but that's okay. I hope that those who do like it enjoy it!
Tweet your screenshots and reactions to me @solariancomic on Twitter! I would love to be able to see in real-time what people think!

You can also take a look at my code and use it as a base for your own mod. Just please do not copy any of my dialogue or exact scenes. If you also have any fixes or additions that you'd like to contribute, I would gladly accept that! Please contact me at any time!


Thank you all so much!
